item.title: Snowmobilers must stay off railway tracks: Police
item.description: Snowmobilers are riding on railway tracks in Sault Ste. Marie, That’s not legal or safe, police say. Snowy conditions, helmets and noise from snowmobile engines and wind can make trains and railway equipment difficult to hear. Trains need significant distance to stop. Anyone who sees snowmobilers on railway tracks should call police. Riders may be […]

item.title: Assault alleged at downtown Sault business
item.description: A security guard was assaulted at a business in the 200 block of Bay Street on Wednesday, police say. Rebecca Sangestino, 35, was charged with assault and two counts fail to comply with probation order. Her court order is March 20.
